thread:
Nina Park: Quick ops thread for Friday's webinar (9am PT). Need owners for: reg confirmation copy, Typeform->HubSpot mapping, Zoom recording/upload, captions & clips.
Omar Khan: I'll be Zoom co-host and handle cloud recording + upload to S3. Set me as co-host now.
Jules Rivera: I'll draft confirmation + 24h/72h follow-ups. Will include calendar add, on-demand permission, and caption timing.
Nina Park: S3 path: redwood-marketing/events/2026-webinars/{slug}/. Please include speaker metadata file.
Omar Khan: Upload snippet I'll use:
```
aws s3 cp /tmp/zoom/recording.mp4 s3://redwood-marketing/events/2026-webinars/${SLUG}/recording.mp4 --acl private
aws s3 cp /tmp/zoom/transcript.json s3://redwood-marketing/events/2026-webinars/${SLUG}/transcript.json
```
Jules Rivera: Typeform fields -> HubSpot: email=email, name=firstname+lastname, company=company, role=jobtitle, consent=marketing_opt_in. Add hidden utm_campaign=webinar_q3_2026.
Nina Park: Captions: keep raw VTT from Zoom, we'll send to vendor. Note in email: "Captions available within 48 hours."
dev-bot: Preflight reminder scheduled: 2026-07-10T08:45:00Z  mic check + co-host permissions + cloud recording ON.
Omar Khan: I'll enable "optimize for third-party editor" in cloud recording and ensure chat auto-save. I'll upload raw VTT + JSON transcript.
Jules Rivera: Clips plan: 2x 2-3min highlights + 30s social cut. Jules to confirm exact timestamps after transcript.
Nina Park: Post-event cadence: 24h recording to registrants; 72h reminder to non-viewers; create HubSpot lists for attendees vs registrants-only. Jules will wire workflows.
ops-bot: If cloud recording not available within 30m after end, tag #eng-oncall.
Omar Khan: Will post S3 link and CloudFront link here after upload.
Jules Rivera: Draft confirmation posted to thread in 10.
Nina Park: Thanks team  keep updates here.
